id.description: The root turn ID. Use this ID as the pagination anchor.

object.description: The object type, which is always `agent.session.trace`.

session_id.description: The session that owns this trace.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp in seconds when the root turn was created.

otlp.description: An OTLP JSON ExportTraceServiceRequest containing resourceSpans. Only currently published data is returned; later trace updates are not awaited.
